prompt_text:
Model a military command-and-control infrastructure: a web-based command portal
for officers, a situational awareness REST API aggregating sensor feeds, a
PostgreSQL tactical database for mission data, a NATS message bus for encrypted
inter-unit communication, an intelligence feed service ingesting threat data,
a Vault instance for secrets and key management, an audit trail service for
compliance, a SIEM for security monitoring, and Prometheus/Grafana for system
health. All backend services must be fully isolated from the public-facing portal.
